title: Every App Eventually Becomes a Dashboard. Please Make It Stop.
why_read: A humorous but fairly shallow rant about feature creep turning simple apps into dashboards, light on concrete technical guidance.
analysis: This piece is a conversational, meme-style complaint about how software products inevitably accumulate dashboards, widgets, and enterprise features over time. It captures a real and relatable phenomenon in product development, known broadly as feature creep or scope creep. However, the excerpt shown is mostly comedic framing without deep technical analysis of causes or solutions. It may resonate with engineers and product people but offers limited actionable insight.
